narrative.recommendations_md:
6 recommendations | All technologies validated absent before inclusion | No investment amounts, estimates, or timelines | Each aligned to OB's 2025 strategic objectives
The following six recommendations address the confirmed capability gaps identified in Sections 6-8. Each recommendation maps to one of OB's seven 2025 strategic objectives, cites specific evidence for the root cause, confirms the technology is not currently deployed, and identifies the named economic buyer. The recommendations are presented in dependency sequence — R-01 (FSC) establishes the financial services data model that R-03, R-05, and R-06 require; R-02 (MuleSoft) establishes the API layer that R-04 (Data Cloud) requires.

narrative.roadmap_md:
Dependency-sequenced platform roadmap. No investment amounts, cost estimates, or timelines. Phases reflect logical sequencing, not calendar commitments.
The transformation roadmap reflects the dependency architecture of the Salesforce platform: Financial Services Cloud (R-01) establishes the financial services data model on which all subsequent solutions depend. MuleSoft (R-02) creates the API integration layer that Data Cloud (R-04) requires to unify Broadridge data. Experience Cloud (R-03) extends FSC's financial account objects to a client-facing portal. Marketing Cloud (R-05) connects to FSC's client and prospect records. Agentforce (R-06) operates most effectively when it has both FSC relationship context and Data Cloud unified account data. This sequence is not arbitrary — each phase creates the foundation the next phase requires.
